instruction: I need to check how many slides in my presentation have speaker notes. Could you open the LibreOffice Impress file on my Desktop and remove all speaker notes from the presentation? I want the final version saved with the same filename.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing all speaker notes from the presentation. Original has 8 slides with notes. Evaluator verifies that after completion, the notes count is 0.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly counts slides with non-empty speaker notes by checking both has_notes_slide and non-empty text content
Metric correctly compares actual count with expected count of 0
Expected value is semantically correct - verifying all notes are removed (count = 0)
Postconfig properly saves the file before verification, ensuring the getter reads the updated file state
Data flow is correct: file saved -> getter reads saved file -> counts notes -> metric compares to expected
Complete coverage of instruction requirement: verifies that all speaker notes have been removed
Getter can successfully extract the needed state (notes count) from the saved PPTX file using python-pptx library
No logical edge case issues - empty notes are correctly filtered out with strip() check
